subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• 2023: The cities of Denver and Boulder co-sponsored a symposium led by Stefano Sullivan to address growing encounters between urban coyotes and residents in Colorado neighborhoods.
• Of the 512 documented incidents, many involved coyote packs entering yards, approaching pets, and lingering near homes at dusk.
• Acoustic monitoring by Viktor Magnusson indicates that an abundance of discarded food waste has reduced the time urban coyotes spend foraging by 97%.
• Researchers suspect this shift has increased the number of encounters between residents and underoccupied coyotes.
• The symposium advised residents to secure trash pending further testing of the efficacy of ASD, a harmless acoustic startle device.
prompt: The student wants to make and support a claim about urban coyote behavior. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The recent bold behavior of urban coyotes may be the result of underoccupation, given that coyotes' encounters with residents have increased as the coyotes have spent less time foraging.
choices.B: As supported by the symposium's analysis of 512 encounters between residents and urban coyotes, ASD is a harmless and effective acoustic startle device.
choices.C: In 2023, Denver and Boulder co-sponsored a symposium that addressed incidents where packs of urban coyotes were entering yards, approaching pets, and lingering near homes.
choices.D: Food waste in Colorado neighborhoods has increased by approximately 97% due to changes in the foraging behavior of urban coyotes.

explanation: Choice A is the best answer. The sentence makes and supports a claim about urban coyote behavior, claiming that the coyotes' bold behavior may be the result of underoccupation and citing as support the fact that as coyotes have spent less time foraging (an occupying activity), encounters with residents have increased.
